```mermaid
classDiagram
    direction LR

    class NodeInternals {
        <<final>>
        +sourceRange(Node, LineMap, int, int)$ void
        +endSourceRange(Element, LineMap, int, int)$ void
        +clearEndSourceRange(Element)$ void
        +sourceDataStart(ProcessingInstruction, int)$ void
        +attributeRange(Attributes, String, LineMap, int, int, int, int)$ void
        +attributeRange(Attributes, String, Range.AttributeRange)$ void
    }

    class Node {
        <<abstract>>
        +sourceRange() Range
    }
    class LeafNode {
        <<abstract>>
    }
    class Element
    class ProcessingInstruction
    class Attributes
    class Range
    class RangeSpans["Range.Spans"]
    class RangeAttributeRange["Range.AttributeRange"]
    class LineMap
    class Validate

    class TreeBuilder {
        <<abstract>>
        ~lineMap() LineMap
    }
    class HtmlTreeBuilder
    class XmlTreeBuilder
    class HtmlTreeBuilderState {
        <<enumeration>>
    }
    class Cleaner
    class Token {
        <<abstract>>
    }
    class TokenTag["Token.Tag"] {
        <<abstract>>
    }

    %% Types used by NodeInternals
    NodeInternals ..> Node
    NodeInternals ..> Element
    NodeInternals ..> ProcessingInstruction
    NodeInternals ..> Attributes
    NodeInternals ..> RangeSpans
    NodeInternals ..> RangeAttributeRange
    NodeInternals ..> LineMap
    NodeInternals ..> Validate

    %% Types that use NodeInternals
    Cleaner ..> NodeInternals
    TreeBuilder ..> NodeInternals
    HtmlTreeBuilder ..> NodeInternals
    XmlTreeBuilder ..> NodeInternals
    HtmlTreeBuilderState ..> NodeInternals
    TokenTag ..> NodeInternals

    %% Supporting relationships among the above
    Element --|> Node
    LeafNode --|> Node
    ProcessingInstruction --|> LeafNode
    Node ..> Range
    Node ..> RangeSpans
    Range *-- RangeSpans
    Range *-- RangeAttributeRange
    Attributes ..> RangeSpans
    ProcessingInstruction ..> RangeSpans
    Cleaner ..> RangeAttributeRange
    HtmlTreeBuilder --|> TreeBuilder
    XmlTreeBuilder --|> TreeBuilder
    TreeBuilder ..> LineMap
    TokenTag --|> Token
    TokenTag --> TreeBuilder : treeBuilder
```
